## Why the current behavior is not enough

Name the command, tool, or doc page. If this would change a default in [`SPEC.md`](../../SPEC.md), say so. Frozen v1.0 defaults and the on-disk store shape are not casual edits.

## What should stay the same

Advisory-first is intentional: the suite records and surfaces problems. It is not a sandbox and it does not prove a change is correct.
